b. Diarrhoea
Diarrhoea means that proper amounts of water are not absorbed from colon
and the required water leaves the body along with faeces.The main symptoms
of diarrhoea are frequent, watery, loose bowel movements, abdominal pain,
nausea and vomiting.Diarrhoea results in dehydration, which means the body
lacksenoughfluidtofunctionproperly.
Diarrhea is caused bybacterial, viral or parasitic infection of the colon walls.It is
treated by consuming adequate amounts ofwaterpreferably mixed with salts
andnutrients toreplace theloss.When diarrhoea is due tobacterial infection,it
is treatedbyadministrationofantibiotics.Diarrhoea can be prevented bytaking
sufficientamountsofcleanwaterandfood.
c.Uicers
An ulcer is a small erosion (hole) in the walls of thegut. It usually occurs in the
walls of stomach and is called gastric ulcer.It may also develop in duodenum
(duodenal ulcer)or oesophagus (oesophageal ulcer).The symptoms of ulcer
includeabdominalburningandpain,lossofappetiteandweightloss.
